Is yoga just stretching—or is there something deeper happening spiritually?
In this video, we take a closer look at the spiritual origins of yoga and explore its surprising parallels to the pagan god, Baal. While yoga is often promoted in the West as a harmless form of exercise, its roots trace back to deeply spiritual rituals and philosophies. So, can Christians practice yoga? See for yourself.
